question: For each negative on the frontier, can a QUESTION-level cause be excluded, or does the record leave one open?
why_this_is_needed: research/self_rakl_recursive_question_audit_v1/CORE.md returns CANNOT_CHECK__SOURCE_VOCABULARY_CANNOT_EXPRESS_THE_COORDINATE for the QUESTION coordinate: the frontier attributes execution-stage failure and its vocabulary has no question-level category, so a question-level cause could not have been recorded even if present. The audit's programme-level RUN_DISCRIMINATOR asks for an instrument whose vocabulary CAN express that coordinate. This is the smallest such instrument, covering one Q subtype rather than claiming the whole coordinate.

scope.covers: Q_REGIME_CONFLATION only — the closure packet's Q cause reads 'the active scientific question is malformed, over-demanding, or conflates information regimes'. This instrument addresses the third clause and no other.
does_not_cover: malformed questions that declare their regime correctly
over-demanding questions whose information assumptions are explicit and honest
any judgement about whether the registered question was the right question to ask
scope.consequence: A record scored REGIME_DECLARED has one Q subtype excluded, not the QUESTION coordinate cleared.

instrument.name: regime-declaration probe
instrument.logic: The observation contract merged in #726 makes a question's information assumptions a first-class object: acquisition regime, licensed input sources, permitted normalizers, external-knowledge policy. A design that never declared these could not have detected that its question conflated regimes, so a regime-conflation cause cannot be excluded for it. A design that declared them has that subtype excluded by construction.
instrument.reads: the record's pre-execution design artifacts only
instrument.never_reads: the record's terminal, what_happened, one_stage_attribution or core_lever fields

markers.regime: acquisition regime or information regime named (source-grounded / semantic / external / world-knowledge / benchmark-reproduction)
markers.sources: the licensed input fields or columns enumerated
markers.normalizer: semantic normalization explicitly permitted or forbidden
markers.external: external or world knowledge explicitly permitted or forbidden

frozen_verdicts.REGIME_DECLARED: the design names its regime AND its licensed sources. Regime conflation is excluded for this record.
frozen_verdicts.REGIME_PARTIAL: some but not all markers present. Conflation is not excluded, and the specific missing marker is reported.
frozen_verdicts.Q_REGIME_CONFLATION_NOT_EXCLUDED: no marker present in any design artifact. A question-level regime cause remains open for this record.
frozen_verdicts.CANNOT_CHECK__NO_DESIGN_ARTIFACT: the record lists no pre-execution artifact, or none is on disk. Not scored as either exclusion or non-exclusion.

non_circularity: No outcome field is read. The probe cannot be circular with the negatives it is scoring, because it never sees how any of them closed.

construct_independence_declaration.CHANNEL_SEPARATION: SATISFIED — only pre-execution design artifacts are read; the terminal and attribution fields are excluded by path, not by convention
construct_independence_declaration.AUTHOR_SEPARATION: PARTIAL — the design artifacts were authored by earlier sessions of this programme, not by an independent party. Declared as partial rather than satisfied.
construct_independence_declaration.GOLD_INDEPENDENCE: NOT_APPLICABLE — this is a census-type measurement with no gold and no scored prediction
construct_independence_declaration.PERMUTATION_NULL: NOT_APPLICABLE — there is no statistic to shuffle labels against
construct_independence_declaration.gate_scope_note: Two obligations are not applicable, so the merged gate would return CANNOT_CHECK for this instrument. That is a scope limit of the gate rather than a defect in this probe: the gate was specified for scored comparisons against gold, not for censuses. Recorded here rather than worked around.

falsifier: If every record scores REGIME_DECLARED, the instrument is vacuous — it would mean the vocabulary gap the audit found does not exist at the design layer, and the CANNOT_CHECK should be attributed elsewhere. If every record scores NOT_EXCLUDED, the probe is equally uninformative: a marker set that nothing satisfies measures the marker set, not the designs.
non_claims: A NOT_EXCLUDED verdict is not evidence that the question WAS malformed. It records that the design cannot rule the cause out.
This does not retract, promote or reinterpret any frontier terminal.
Excluding one Q subtype does not clear the QUESTION coordinate; the audit's CANNOT_CHECK stands for every subtype this instrument does not cover.
Grants no scientific or method-promotion authority.
